question: Can a deterministic per-image choice along the already frozen AO6 strength path reduce between-image residual-dose dispersion while retaining AO6 style, non-basic structure and severe-artifact safety?
development_status: post-hoc policy development on the fully seen AO6 population; no confirmatory claim

policy.distance: absolute difference between the candidate's measured per-image median Delta E76 from the exact B0 output and the fixed target
policy.tie_break: lower tone strength, then lower chroma strength, then candidate_id

visual_gate.population: the same nine fully seen AO6 gold images; development only

branch_rules.automatic_fail: close the adaptive-dose policy without threshold or target rescue
branch_rules.visual_fail: retain fixed AO6 development evidence and close this dose policy; do not acquire confirmation data
branch_rules.development_pass: freeze the exact policy and acquire a genuinely unused rights-cleared photo population before any independent claim

claim_ceiling: post-hoc AO6 development evidence for deterministic bounded strength selection along one existing display-proxy residual direction; not independent preference, stock response, calibration, latent mode, content retrieval or product promotion
